item.title: Elegant WordPress Clinic Redesign
item.description:
30-250 USD | Our medical clinic site is overdue for a full facelift. It must stay on WordPress, retain every ounce of our existing SEO equity, and load noticeably faster on both mobile and desktop.
Primary objective I want visitors to feel immediate confidence in our expertise—polished visuals, refined typography, and a premium colour palette that signal professionalism and care.
Key trust-building areas • Doctor & staff profiles: new photo guidelines, credentials displayed clearly, and a design that lets personalities shine without clutter. • Patient reviews, ratings, success stories: dynamic yet lightweight sections that are easy for my team to update while remaining schema-friendly for search engines. • Service pages: concise treatment overviews, pricing cues where appropriate, and expandable FAQ blocks so patients find answers without hunting.
Technical must-haves – Remain on WordPress with a theme framework that is actively maintained. – Core Web Vitals improvements: sub-2-second first contentful paint and an A rating on GTmetrix. – Clean code, structured data, and SEO plugins configured exactly as they are now (Yoast). – Smooth appointment-booking integration with our existing Calendly embed. – Staging environment for review before going live.
Deliverables 1. High-fidelity Figma mock-ups for all top-level pages. 2. Fully developed WordPress site migrated to our host, including redirects and image optimisation. 3. Launch support plus a short hand-off video showing my staff how to update content.
Acceptance criteria • Desktop and mobile Lighthouse performance score ≥ 90. • No drop in current keyword rankings one month post-launch. • All listed trust-building elements present and functioning.
If you have recent healthcare or clinic examples, point me to them and outline your timeline.

item.title: UK Cleaning Website Build
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I’m launching a domestic and commercial cleaning company in the UK and need a full-function website that does three things beautifully: attracts new enquiries, lets visitors see clear prices and service details, and allows them to book and pay for a clean online.
Core features • Public-facing pages for Regular Home Cleaning, End-of-Tenancy Cleaning and Office/Commercial Cleaning, each with at-a-glance pricing tables and trust-building copy I’ll supply. • A real-time booking engine where customers pick a service, date, extras and postcode, get an instant quote, then pay securely (Stripe or similar). • Simple CMS so I can edit text, prices and availability myself. WordPress with a premium booking plugin is fine, but I’m open to Webflow, Wix or any modern stack you’re confident with. • Quick-load, mobile-first design, optimised for local SEO (schema, meta tags, Google Business integration). • Contact form and click-to-call buttons for visitors who prefer enquiries over bookings.
Deliverables 1. Fully responsive website deployed to my chosen UK host. 2. Booking & payment workflow tested end-to-end. 3. Admin guide (short Loom video or PDF) showing how to update services, prices and booking slots. 4. Two weeks of post-launch support for bug fixes.
To apply, include links to previous service-industry sites you’ve built, a brief overview of your experience with booking/payment integrations, and a concise proposal outlining your approach and timeline. I’m aiming to move quickly, so clarity and relevant examples will put you to the top of the list.

item.title: Luxury Rental WordPress Redesign
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I’m ready to give our luxury vacation-rental brand a website that feels as premium as the homes we offer and, most importantly, converts browsers into paying guests. The current WordPress build looks dated and forces visitors to enquire manually; instead, I want a streamlined experience where they can choose a property, see live availability, and pay on the spot.
Scope and objectives • Re-skin or rebuild the site in WordPress so every page loads fast, looks stunning on mobile, and carries a cohesive high-end aesthetic. • Integrate a robust booking engine—WooCommerce with accommodation add-ons or a purpose-built vacation-rental plugin is fine—as long as guests can complete the entire reservation and payment process without leaving the site. • Structure pages, metadata, and internal links for stronger organic search visibility, then fine-tune performance so Core Web Vitals pass comfortably. • Secure the site (SSL, PCI-compliant checkout), connect Stripe and PayPal, and test cross-browser/device. • Hand over a concise guide or short Loom video so my team can add properties, adjust rates, and manage bookings in-house.
Key details • Timeline: 2–4 weeks from kickoff to launch. • Tech stack: WordPress, Elementor or comparable visual builder is acceptable; WooCommerce or any rental-specific booking plugin that supports real-time calendars, coupon codes, and automated emails. • Design inspiration: upscale, editorial feel—think large hero imagery, clean typography, effortless navigation.
Deliverables (acceptance criteria) 1. Fully responsive WordPress site with luxury design applied to all core templates. 2. End-to-end direct booking and payment flow working in sandbox and live modes. 3. PageSpeed Insights score of 90+ on mobile and desktop. 4. On-page SEO best practices implemented (titles, meta descriptions, schema for each listing). 5. One-hour handover session plus supporting documentation.
If this aligns with your skill set in WordPress, booking integrations, mobile optimisation, and SEO, let’s talk and map out the next s
The site still needs some work on optimization, though particularly the mobile version. Here's some websites you can refer to for inspiration: https://evergreencabins.co/ https://staytreetopescapes.com/

item.title: Comprehensive Condo Management System with Multi-Level Access
item.description:
250-750 USD | We are looking to develop an advanced condominium management system tailored for a complex with 136 units. The system should feature five distinct levels of access and enable domain-based email setup for all functionalities.
Key Features by Access Level: 1. General Public Access: - Information about the complex, including photos and contact details. - Public-facing pages with an engaging design.
2. Owners Portal: - Secure login to view and pay bills. - Access documents like By-Laws, rules and regulations. - Submit and track maintenance work order requests.
3. Administration (Property Manager): - Dashboard to manage website content and functionality. - Detailed management of all maintenance work orders (add, track, search). - Separate lists for pending, ongoing, and completed work orders. - Ability to archive finished tasks for easy reference.
4. Maintenance Personnel Access: - View and update the status of all assigned work orders (pending, in progress, completed). - Prioritize tasks based on urgency. - Log estimated hours, cost, supplies required/used, and personnel involved in each task.
5. Board of Directors Portal: - View progress reports for all maintenance tasks. - Ensure no personal information regarding owners is visible.
Additional Requirements: - Integrated email services using the domain name. - Mobile-friendly design. - Secure database management solution with clear user roles and permissions.
Ideal Candidate Skills: - Expertise in developing robust web platforms with multi-level access controls. - Proficiency in UI/UX design for both public-facing and internal portals. - Strong background in database management and backend development. - Familiarity with domain-based email integrations.
Please share samples of similar projects you’ve worked on and provide an estimated timeline for completion.

item.title: Website Update and SEO Boost

item.title: Multi-Vendor Marketplace Revamp
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to take AfghanOutlet to the next level and the first step is tightening up the foundations of the site and its vendor dashboard. Our immediate priority is to make the platform clean, fast and effortless for both sellers and shoppers so that future SEO work and paid campaigns can perform at their full potential.
Here is what I need in this phase:
• Vendor product, stock and order management – simplify the workflow so vendors can add, edit and fulfil items with minimal clicks, clear notifications and real-time stock status. • Customer shopping, checkout and account pages – create a friction-free path from product discovery through purchase, with secure payments and intuitive account tools. • Website speed, mobile layout and overall design – optimise Core Web Vitals, polish the UI for all screen sizes and ensure the look remains consistent with our brand.
I’m happy to provide full access to the current codebase, analytics and any design assets you require. Before we begin, I’d like to see a detailed project proposal that explains:

Once the core platform performs flawlessly, I plan to move straight into on-page SEO, Facebook/Instagram ads, Google Shopping feeds and vendor acquisition campaigns—so a roadmap for how today’s work feeds tomorrow’s growth will stand out.
Looking forward to reviewing your proposal and getting AfghanOutlet fully primed for scale.

item.title: Fix Errors & Plan UNA Migration
item.description:
250-750 USD | My community site is misbehaving in a few critical areas and I need someone to step in quickly. Right now several pages and key features have stopped working: user profiles won’t load correctly, messaging and notifications throw sporadic errors, and even the admin dashboard—especially content posting and the search function—acts up.
The first milestone is to stabilise the existing code-base: trace the root causes, clean up the bugs, and return every affected section to full functionality. Once the platform is solid again, I’d like a concise, actionable roadmap for moving the whole site to the UNA platform. That plan should outline each step, estimate effort, highlight possible data-migration hurdles, and flag any third-party modules that might need replacements or custom builds.
Deliverables • Fully functional current site (profiles, messaging/notifications, admin content tools, search) • Technical report summarising what was fixed and how • Migration blueprint to UNA with timelines, resource estimates, and risk mitigation notes
I’ll give server and code access as soon as we start. Familiarity with PHP, MySQL, and UNA’s architecture will be a clear advantage. If this sounds like a smooth fit, let’s get the fixes done and map out the next chapter for the site.

item.title: Ongoing WordPress Maintenance & Security
item.description:
250-750 USD | My WordPress site needs steady, knowledgeable attention so it stays secure, fast, and problem-free day after day. The ongoing workload centres on three areas:
• Plugins, backups, and security – keeping every component updated on a staging copy first, scheduling reliable off-site backups, running regular scans, and hardening the install against new threats. • Performance tuning – analysing load times, refining caching and image optimisation, and tracking the results so we see clear speed gains. • General site management – jumping in quickly when an error appears, tidying small layout glitches, and handling the occasional content tweak.
This is a long-term arrangement rather than a single overhaul. Consistent weekly maintenance, clear communication, and a proactive mindset are essential. Familiarity with typical WordPress tooling (cPanel, phpMyAdmin, Cloudflare, popular optimisation and security plugins) will make the work straightforward.
Deliverables the first month: 1. Safe update process documented and running on a schedule 2. Automated daily backups verified and stored off-site 3. Security scan with issues resolved or documented 4. Baseline performance report with an action plan for improvements
Ongoing: the same checks each month, rapid fixes within 24 hours when something breaks, and a brief monthly summary of work completed.
If this fits your expertise and you’re available for consistent weekly / monthly touch-points, I’d like to hear how you normally structure maintenance and monitoring.

item.title: Driving School Website Refresh

item.title: Build a Wix Seminary Ecosystem
item.description:

I am seeking an experienced Wix developer and designer to rebuild my current GoDaddy website www.foresttherapeutics.us on Wix. This is not a simple business website. It is an online educational and spiritual ecosystem, a seminary and a university devoted to earth based spirituality, nature and elemental wisdom, Christ Consciousness as an inner frequency, and embodied personal transformation. The site serves as an educational institution, an online university, a digital course platform, an ecommerce store, a booking platform, a media center, and a public doorway into my wider community and coursework. The overall feel should be professional, educational, spiritual, and nature focused, welcoming and easy to navigate, fully mobile friendly, and strongly optimized for search. My current GoDaddy site has suffered persistent indexing and visibility problems, broken links, and outages, and curing that is a central reason for the move.
The Governing Principle, Build the House and I Will Arrange the Furniture
I will retain full owner control of the finished site. I manage, edit, and update it myself after launch, and I add, change, or remove features as my needs grow. For this reason the build must rest on standard, native Wix features and the Wix Editor wherever possible, rather than on locked custom code that only a developer can maintain. Think of this as building the house and setting every room in working order. I will arrange and rearrange the furniture myself. Ease of owner management after launch is a true requirement, and any custom work must be documented plainly so I can maintain it on my own.
The Platform Architecture, Three Houses That Work Together
My ecosystem lives across three connected platforms, and understanding this division is essential so that nothing is rebuilt that already lives elsewhere. Wix is the public house, holding the website, the storefront, the booking system, the public events, the media center, the blog, and the search presence, and it carries clean doorways into the other two. This is the house being built in this project. WithMe is the inner house, already built and staying in place, where my private member community, my membership tiers, my member only live classes, and my student coaching already live, so Wix links out to WithMe and does not rebuild community or memberships. SkillSpring is the classroom, holding my structured coursework, student tracking, and certificates, which I administer myself, so Wix integrates and links to SkillSpring but does not build the coursework. All paid functions run through Stripe.
Scope of Work
1. Full Website Rebuild Recreate and improve the current website on Wix, with stronger navigation, a cleaner site architecture, faster load speed, and full mobile responsiveness.
2. University and Seminary Structure Present my multiple educational divisions clearly, each with its own pages, descriptions, enrollment information, and curriculum overview. These include my digital university, my correspondence by mail school, my courses on sovereign technology and analog living, and my certification and future degree programs.
3. Ecommerce Store A robust Wix store carrying digital products such as course downloads, PDFs, e-books, and recorded workshops, membership and subscription products where they are introduced, and physical products such as ritual tools, apothecary supplies, books, and educational materials. The store runs on Stripe.
4. Dropshipping Integration My physical supplies are dropshipped through AzureGreen. The store should support physical listings, inventory, order fulfillment, and shipping calculation, and I welcome your recommendation for the cleanest Wix compatible dropshipping workflow. I will provide my product files.
5. Booking and Appointment System Using Wix Bookings, online scheduling with payment, confirmations, and reminders for my public services and classes, including in person sessions and online sessions that use the native Zoom connection.
6. Events and Ticketing Using Wix Events, the ability to create events, sell tickets, and host online events for public workshops and gatherings, with online events using the native Zoom connection.
7. Media Center A searchable, organized media area for podcast and television appearances, interviews, articles, publications, and speaking engagements.
8. Blog A robust, search friendly blog with categories across spirituality, earth based wisdom, ecology, community updates, and courses and events.
9. Video Hosting Using native Wix video, host or embed recorded teaching and marketing videos, with the ability to protect certain videos behind member access where needed.
10. File Hosting and Protected Downloads Secure hosting for PDFs, handouts, worksheets, and student materials, with some downloads restricted by access level. Preferably on Wix or my current LMS SkillSpring.
11. Email Automation Using native Wix automation, set up welcome and gift delivery sequences for new subscribers, enrollment sequences for new students, reminders for participants and appointments, and access instructions for purchases.
12. SEO Setup Complete search optimization, including Google Search Console, sitemap creation and submission, Google Business Profile integration, metadata and image optimization, mobile optimization, and indexing verification. Curing my current indexing failures is a priority outcome.
13. Domain Connection or Transfer Assistance connecting my primary domain, ForestTherapeutics.us, to the new Wix site, with guidance on whether to transfer the registration or simply point it to Wix.
14. Content Migration Guidance and help migrating my text, images, PDFs, videos, courses, blog posts, store products, and SEO assets from GoDaddy to Wix, understanding this is a rebuild rather than an automatic transfer.
What Is Out of Scope To keep the project lean and clear, the following are not part of this build and are only integrated or linked. The member community and the membership tiers, which live on WithMe. The structured coursework and certificates, which live in SkillSpring. And PayPal, which is not used anywhere.
Phased Delivery I would welcome the build delivered in sensible phases, so that a clean and beautiful landing and enrollment doorway can open first while the deeper architecture rises behind it, followed by the store and membership links, the SkillSpring integration and gated areas, the bookings and events, and finally the automations, the full SEO setup, and the content migration. I welcome your proposed phase plan and an honest timeline for each stage.
What I Will Provide I will provide all of my written content, my images and logos, my brand colors and aesthetic direction, my product files, and the access the work requires. My aesthetic is earthy, natural, elegant, grounded, and gently mystical, drawing on warm earth tones, goldenrod and forest greens, and vintage woodcut and old world apothecary accents, with a timeless, literary feeling.
Who I Am Looking For I am looking for a developer who has built complex Wix ecosystems before, not only simple business sites, and who is comfortable with Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix automations, SEO setup, and integrations with outside platforms such as SkillSpring or other LMS and Stripe. Clear communication, honest timelines, and a willingness to leave me in full control of my own site afterward matter as much to me as technical skill.
This is not a simple business website. It is an online educational and spiritual ecosystem consisting of a seminary, a digital university, a membership community, an ecommerce store, a media center, and a student platform. Experience building complex Wix ecosystems is strongly preferred.
How to Apply
In your proposal, please tell me briefly about Wix ecosystems you have built, confirm your experience with Wix Stores, Bookings, Events, and outside integrations such as SkillSpring, Moodle and Stripe, share your proposed phase plan and a realistic timeline, and outline how you structure milestones and payment.
I look forward to building something beautiful and lasting together.
